strategy_rationale: Multi-asset quant strategy book with per-class engines: EQUITY uses Two-Day RSI Reversal (mean-reversion in uptrend — Long when 2 consecutive down days, RSI(2) < 25, Price > EMA(200)). CRYPTO uses Multi-Timeframe Trend (momentum — Long when Daily/Weekly EMAs align: Price > EMA20 > EMA50). COMMODITY uses Carry-Momentum Double Sort (factor-based — Short bottom quintile, Long top quintile). ETF uses Sector Rotation (tactical allocation based on momentum and volatility regime). FOREX and BOND are research-only (experimental, insufficient data). Primary failure modes: EQUITY killed by choppy bear markets/gap-down continuation; CRYPTO killed by EMA crossover/chop and funding flips; COMMODITY killed by momentum reversals and inaccurate carry proxies. Kill condition: rolling 50-trade PF < 1.0 or WR < 45%.

failure_modes.EQUITY: Choppy bear markets; gap-down continuation invalidates mean-reversion assumption. RSI(2) < 25 can persist in crash regimes.
failure_modes.CRYPTO: EMA crossover/chop in ranging markets; funding rate flips from positive to negative invalidating trend-following bias.
failure_modes.COMMODITY: Momentum reversals during supply shocks; inaccurate contango/backwardation carry estimates from futures roll yield approximation.
failure_modes.ETF: Sector mean-reversion during risk-off; regime gate 'skip' windows when VIX > 30.
failure_modes.kill_condition: Rolling 50-trade Profit Factor < 1.0 or Win Rate < 45% for any individual asset class engine.
